Spending limit for automatic AI (US dollars per 30 days)

Auto-organize and reading text with the assistant pause once this library's estimated AI spend over the last 30 days reaches this many dollars (now %1$d; 0 means no limit). Everything counts towards it, including what you start yourself, but only the automatic work pauses. Requests without a known price do not count. Allowed range: %2$d–%3$d.

Automatic AI is paused: this library spent %1$s on AI in the last 30 days, which reached the limit of %2$s. New documents are read on this device and wait to be organized until the spend drops below the limit or you raise it.
